## Polling averages update

All numbers are as of 1:00 PM Eastern on Aug. 21, 2026.

### 2026 U.S. House generic ballot

The Democratic margin in the 2026 U.S. House generic ballot stayed steady at Democrats +6 this week. We saw almost no change in the past week, with both Democrats and Republicans moving up by 0.1 percentage point.

### Trump’s job approval [...] President Trump’s approval rating among U.S. adults remained underwater by 24 percentage points this week. His disapproval fell slightly from 60.4 percent last week to 59.9 percent this week, while his approval rating dropped from 36.3 percent to 36.1 percent.
